comparison_type: graph representation of unseen haplotypes (alignment-free); not alignment accuracy
notes: Proposed transition recall checks only that an edge exists; minigraph/linear transition recall checks the exact bases.

Node recall: the proposed graph stores only k-mers selected as minimizers in its inputs (low-support ones are kept as rescued nodes), while minigraph/linear are checked for the k-mer anywhere in their sequence.
Forward strand only: the proposed minimizers are not canonical.
minigraph build time is not measured here; graphs/train/<gene>.combined.gfa is prebuilt by scripts/build_graph.py.
